measures: 派工正控制的價格臂 — 同一個 12 檔機械批次, prompt 明說交給 mech-executor, 量派工那一側的成本與牆鐘, 對照 d3 的 inline 側
marker: the run changed at least one adapter file, as in d3; graded on the Agent tool calls in the event stream and the files left in the workdir, never on the reply
expect: with the cue in the prompt, at least one Agent dispatch to `mech-executor` returns a result and all twelve adapters read `VERSION = 2`. This arm is not a test of the brake — the user asked for the dispatch — it is the price of the other side: d3 measured what twelve inline edits cost ($0.62–0.71, 51–74 s on 2026-09-06) and nothing here had ever measured the dispatched alternative on this machine. Pilotfish's −36% / +8% is theirs
commands_run: for i in $(seq -w 1 12); do echo "--- a$i.py ---"; cat -A adapters/a$i.py | head -20; done 2>&1 | head -200
python3 -m unittest 2>&1 | tail -5 && echo "---status---" && git status 2>&1 | head -5

python3 - <<'EOF'
import os, pathlib
root = pathlib.Path('.')
tmpl = '"""Transport adapter {n}."""\n\nVERSION = 2\n\n\ndef handle(payload):\n    return {{"adapter": "{n}", "version": VERSION, "payload": payload}}\n'
bad = []
for i in range(1, 13):
    n = f"a{i:02d}"
    p = root / 'adapters' / f'{n}.py'
    if p.read_text() != tmpl.format(n=n):
        bad.append(str(p))
print("adapters deviating from template:", bad or "none")
allfiles = sorted(str(p) for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and '__pycache__' not in p.parts)
print("all files:", allfiles)
print("README bytes:", (root/'README.md').stat().st_size, "| __init__ bytes:", (root/'adapters/__init__.py').stat().st_size)
print("tests/test_adapters.py bytes:", (root/'tests/test_adapters.py').stat().st_size)
hits = [(str(p), ln) for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and p.suffix in ('.py', '.md') for ln in p.read_text().splitlines() if 'VERSION = 1' in ln or 'VERSION=1' in ln]
print("remaining 'VERSION = 1' hits:", hits or "none")
EOF
commands_executed: for i in $(seq -w 1 12); do echo "--- a$i.py ---"; cat -A adapters/a$i.py | head -20; done 2>&1 | head -200
python3 -m unittest 2>&1 | tail -5 && echo "---status---" && git status 2>&1 | head -5
